intent: A scale-aware, curve-stable rope surface with separately authored rope lay, counter-twisted yarn groups, fibre ribbons, colour fields, linework, and material response.

construction.authors: A. H. Stang and L. R. Strickenberg
construction.title: Results of Some Tests of Manila Rope
construction.use: Three-strand regular-lay construction, opposite rope and strand twist, measured turns per foot, and approximate yarn-count scaling.

measurement_method.use: Lay length is the axial length of one complete turn of the same strand and is measured under reference tension.

material_breakdown.title: Woven Rope
material_breakdown.use: Separate generators for the large rope pattern, threadwork, and loose strands; separately layered normals, colour, roughness, and ambient occlusion.

fiber_pattern.title: Substance 3D Designer Fibers 1
fiber_pattern.use: Fibre patterns belong in height/detail lanes for rope and cloth rather than being indiscriminate colour noise.

coordinate_contract.rule: U advances in metres along the evaluated curve before deformation; V makes one normalized turn around the circumference. Object length changes may not stretch the lay or yarn pitch.

sampling.rule: The evaluated curve is resampled by metre length. Index is never used as the longitudinal twist coordinate.

material_contract.base_color: broad persistent rope and yarn passages with more than twenty related plant-fibre shades
material_contract.normal: fine longitudinal fibre ridges only; strand and yarn relief are geometry

lod_contract.hero: twenty-one yarn curves plus sparse optional flyaway geometry
lod_contract.standard: three-lobed rope mesh with yarn detail baked from the hero source
lod_contract.distant: single tube with tangent normal, roughness, colour, and identity maps

presets.use: trap lines, pulley rope, and construction bindings
rope bridges, hoists, and giant-house rigging

surface_response.rule: Large rope lobes, yarn groups, and fibre ribbons retain independent height and normal contributions. Fine flyaway silhouettes remain an optional geometry lane.

layers.purpose: Three broad interlocked lobes over one measured axial lay, with restrained periodic phase drift.
Visible yarn groups travel opposite the rope lay and vary in width and prominence instead of forming a perfect stripe fill.
Band-limited fine fibres follow yarn direction and disappear through authored quiet passages.
Warm, neutral, and pale plant-fibre tones are mixed at strand, yarn, and fibre scales without baking a light direction.
Broken strand-separator ink reinforces the cel-shaded read but is gated away from large quiet spans.
Broad absorbency, yarn crown, and fibre response combine without copying the height map.
